contemporary.definition: An interior-design approach reflecting current styles and practices.

traditional.definition: An interior-design approach drawing on established historical furnishings and decoration.

scandinavian.definition: An interior-design tradition often associated with simple forms, light spaces and practical furnishings.

industrial.definition: An interior style using features associated with industrial buildings, such as exposed metal or brick.

bohemian.definition: An eclectic interior style combining varied patterns, objects and textures.

mid-century.definition: Associated with the styles and ideas popular in art, culture, or society around the mid-twentieth century.

farmhouse.definition: An interior style drawing on rural homes and practical, rustic furnishings.

art-deco.definition: A design movement popular during the 1920s and 1930s, known for simplified shapes and geometric patterns suitable for factory production.

japanese.definition: Here, an interior-design tradition informed by Japanese spatial and material practices.

coastal.definition: An interior style drawing on seaside settings through materials, colors or decoration.

color-palette.definition: A coordinated selection of colors used in art, design, or digital media for visual appeal or practical effect.

accent-wall.definition: A wall finished in a different color, material, or pattern to make it stand out from the other walls in a room.
accent-wall.exampleUsage: The designer used dark blue paint on the accent wall.

wallpaper.definition: Decorative paper attached to walls inside a room.

paint.definition: A liquid or paste coating applied to a surface for color or protection.

tile.definition: A thin piece of ceramic, stone, or another material used to cover surfaces.

hardwood.definition: The wood of broad-leaved dicotyledonous trees (as distinguished from the wood of conifers).

stone.definition: Building material consisting of a piece of rock hewn in a definite shape for a special purpose.

marble.definition: A natural stone used for surfaces and decorative features in interiors.

concrete.definition: A hard building material used for paths and surfaces.

chandelier.definition: A decorative light with several arms hanging from the ceiling.

pendant-light.definition: A light fixture suspended from the ceiling by a cord, chain, or rod.
pendant-light.exampleUsage: A pendant light hangs above the dining table.

track-lighting.definition: A lighting system with several adjustable light fixtures mounted along a track.
track-lighting.exampleUsage: Track lighting lets the designer aim light at different displays.

recessed-light.definition: A light fixture installed into a hollow opening in a ceiling so most of it sits above the surface.
recessed-light.exampleUsage: The hallway uses recessed lights in the ceiling.

floor-lamp.definition: A tall freestanding lamp placed on the floor.

table-lamp.definition: A small lamp that stands on a table or desk.

sconce.definition: A decorative wall bracket for holding candles or other sources of light.

natural-light.definition: Daylight entering an interior through openings such as windows or skylights.

dimmer.definition: A rheostat that varies the current through an electric light in order to control the level of illumination.

led-strip.definition: A flexible strip containing many small LED lights, used for decorative or indirect lighting.
led-strip.exampleUsage: An LED strip runs behind the shelf.

area-rug.definition: A movable rug covering part of a room floor.
area-rug.exampleUsage: The area rug defines the seating zone.

curtains.definition: Hanging cloth used as a blind (especially for a window).

throw-pillow.definition: A small cushion placed on sofas or chairs mainly to enhance a room’s appearance.

artwork.definition: A work of visual art displayed as part of an interior.

sculpture.definition: A three-dimensional artwork made by shaping, carving, or assembling materials.

photo-frame.definition: A thin border used to hold and display a photograph.

carpet.definition: A thick textile covering for a floor.

mirror.definition: A reflective surface used to form an image of objects in front of it.

vase.definition: A container used to hold flowers or as a decorative object.

candle.definition: A source of light made from wax around a wick.

plant.definition: A living organism such as a tree, shrub, flower, or houseplant.
